source-integrity.provenance: issuer Q2 2026 results plus prior issuer FY2025/acquisition lineage; independent current market-cap observation retained only for valuation context
source-integrity.freshness: Q2 issuer results published 2026-08-03; market-cap context current September 2026
source-integrity.duplicateOriginCollapse: FY2025 and Crinetics issuer origins remain distinct; Q2 2026 issuer results are a new origin
source-integrity.sourceIndependence: financial/operating facts are issuer-primary; valuation context is independent but not sufficient by itself for a complete valuation model

claims.claim: Q2 2026 revenue was $3.33B, up 12% year over year, and Vertex raised FY2026 revenue guidance to $13.1-$13.2B.
At June 30, 2026 Vertex reported $13.6B of cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities, up from $12.3B at December 31, 2025.
CASGEVY Q2 revenue was $76M (+78% sequentially) and JOURNAVX Q2 revenue was $50M (+71% sequentially), providing realized evidence of non-CF diversification.

The Q2 release identified a November 30, 2026 PDUFA date for povetacicept and still anticipated Crinetics closing in Q3 2026, creating source-timed catalysts but also integration/regulatory execution risk.

September 2026 market capitalization was approximately $133.7B in the independent market source, implying a roughly 10x market-cap/FY2026-revenue-guidance relationship before cash/debt and earnings normalization; this is context, not a full intrinsic-value conclusion.

risks.risk: The $10B Crinetics acquisition raises integration and capital-allocation risk; Q2 guidance explicitly excluded transaction impact pending close.
Clinical/regulatory outcomes and commercial uptake remain material to diversification despite strong Q2 launch growth.
Current market valuation is demanding relative to revenue and requires earnings/pipeline durability for favorable per-share outcomes.

unknowns.unknown: A defensible exact 0-100 value for every Methodology 1.0 component still requires component-by-component source-addressed calibration, especially governancePower, supplyChainResilience, pricingPower and marketValuationOpportunity; no numeric scoreRecord is emitted rather than inventing values.
